CHRISTOPHER: IF YOU'VE STUMBLED INTO THIS TOPIC, STOP READING NOW. I'M DEAD SERIOUS.

NO JOKE, BROSKI. SECRET PLANS ARE BEING MADE HERE.

LET US HAVE A PRIVATE CONVERSATION. WITH EVERYONE.

NOT TO WORRY; NO MALICIOUS INTENT. ONLY GOOD INTENTIONS.

 

 

 

 

 

------------------------------------------------------------------------

 

 

 

 

Alright, is he gone? Paul and Adam, don't tell him about this. I'm hoping some of us fans can do something nice for him. I'm posting this here so it reaches the maximum number of fans who want to help.

I think we all need to surprise Christopher by sending him something nice. In case you guys missed it, he made a rather lengthy post about how much effort goes into this company, and how much he's been doing to please us. He said that last week he put in about 140 hours into work at the GTG office. Do you realize how insane that is? This man essentially lived and breathed for us last week. And the week before, too.

We need to show some mega-appreciation. I seriously think those of us who can should get him some small gifts and send them to the GTG office. I don't care if it's cookies, flowers, a "thank you" card--anything. Let's just do something nice. It's the least he deserves.

Anyone want to join me on this? I think it would mean a lot to him if a lot of us sent things to him. We can make posts on here about how grateful as much as we want, but I think it'd show way more how much we love SotM and the things these guys have done for us if we send physical gifts.

So yeah, these gifts can be anything. Seriously, whatever you can do. Paul and Adam will also be recipiants of these gifts as well (though by now it's less of a surprise for them), but I think it'd be a great gesture for Christopher to emerge from weeks of non-stop work to find a loving fan response.

Someone please tell me they want to join in on this. We'll coordinate what we should send and when.
